title: Backyard patio and planting in Royal Bay

seo.title: Sample project: Royal Bay backyard patio | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: a sloping new-build yard in Royal Bay, Colwood, regraded with a paver patio, low retaining wall and native shrub border.

summary: A bare new-build backyard finished with a patio, retaining wall and planting.
challenge: The bare new-build yard sloped toward the house and held water every winter.
approach: We regraded the yard to fall away from the foundation and built a low block retaining wall to level the patio area.
After the paver patio and sod went in, we planted the border with native shrubs that handle dry summers.
result: A level, usable yard that drains away from the house.
